items.original: 你跟谁在一起你变帅了你以后发生了什么都无所谓你平平安安不缺胳膊少腿就好
items.translation: Whoever you're with, you become handsome. Whatever happens to you in the future doesn't matter, as long as you're safe and sound, with all your limbs intact.
items.label: depression

items.original: 我无法控制自己对你的难以忘怀，只是有关于你的一切，我已经再也不会有所期待了，不再期待能成为你的另一半，也不再期待 ，有关于你的后半身。虽然有的时候我还是会想你，但也并不是非你不可了。
items.translation: I cannot control my lingering thoughts of you, but I no longer hold any expectations about anything concerning you—no longer hoping to become your other half, nor looking forward to the rest of your life. Though I still think of you sometimes, it’s no longer that it has to be you.
items.label: depression

items.original: 听音乐的那些感悟最后一天杀死我，用你擅长的方式。
items.translation: The reflections from listening to music will kill me on the last day, in the way you excel at.
items.label: depression

items.original: 梁振英选香港特首花费“才”1120万，系深圳选个村长都可能唔止尼个数，制度的优劣，各位自己端祥吧
items.translation: Leung Chun-ying spent "only" 11.2 million to run for Hong Kong Chief Executive, while in Shenzhen, even electing a village head might cost more than that. The pros and cons of the system, everyone can judge for themselves.
items.label: normal

items.original: 今天是我的生日08月15日，来祝福我吧~
items.translation: Today is my birthday on August 15th, come and wish me~
items.label: normal

items.original: 还是麻麻好，不动声色的就给充了百元话费~手也快好了呼啦啦~
items.translation: Mom is still the best, quietly topping up my phone with a hundred yuan~ My hand is almost healed, hooray~
items.label: normal

items.original: 我觉得我应该放轻松点这么多年没过过生日突然要大张旗鼓的举办重视确实没必要之前不都这样过来了吗没必要觉得委屈难过想要倾诉谁要听你瞎抱怨呢不如自己放平心态不计较你的诞生本来就不受重视没必要自己非要突出好了别难过了去看个电影追部剧吧都没关系的
items.translation: I think I should take it easy. It's been so many years without celebrating my birthday, and suddenly making a big fuss about it really isn't necessary. Haven't I gotten by just fine all this time? There's no need to feel wronged or sad, or to want to vent—who wants to listen to your pointless complaints anyway? It's better to calm down and not dwell on it. Your birth was never given much importance to begin with, so there's no need to force yourself to stand out. Alright, don't be upset anymore. Go watch a movie or binge a series—it's all fine.
items.label: depression
